description: Schema and metadata of one dataset on a Swiss Opendatasoft portal (SBB, Basel, St. Gallen, Thurgau…): fields (name, label, type, description, facet), record count, licence, publisher, attributions, themes, last modified, and the geo_point field usable for radius search. Call this before query_portal_records to learn field names for where/select/order_by. Example: {portal:'sbb', dataset_id:'passagierfrequenz'}.

dataset_id.description: Dataset id from search_portal_datasets, e.g. 'passagierfrequenz' (SBB) or '100088' (Basel-Stadt ids are numeric)

portal.description: Portal id, alias or domain: 'sbb' (data.sbb.ch), 'basel-stadt' (data.bs.ch), 'basel-landschaft' (data.bl.ch), 'st-gallen' (daten.sg.ch), 'stadt-st-gallen' (daten.stadt.sg.ch), 'graubuenden' (data.gr.ch), 'thurgau' (data.tg.ch); any other '<tenant>.opendatasoft.com' host also works

name: get_portal_dataset
title: Get Opendatasoft dataset schema & licence
